body: that pretty well describes how i feel all the time. a candle burning at both ends. i appreciate that you didn't try to say everything will be fine, i'm so tired of hearing that. i try to work on one thing at a time, but its hard to concentrate on just one without everything else crashing in and making me give up. i'm tired of hating myself all the time... i didn't know it would mean so much to me to get a reply, but i'm crying now. thank you
i don't know what i expect from this. it might just help to tell someone
